title.en: Unit 10 Notes — Maintenance of Sewage System
title.gu: યુનિટ 10 Notes — Sewage System ની Maintenance

h.en: 10.1 Maintenance procedure and causes of trouble
h.gu: 10.1 Maintenance procedure અને trouble ના કારણો

body.en:
Typical procedure:

  1. Review maps and complaints, inspect flow and identify affected reaches.
  2. Plan public protection, traffic control, equipment, isolation or bypass and notification.
  3. Inspect remotely where practicable; use the least hazardous mechanised cleaning method.
  4. Remove, transport and dispose of collected material at an authorised facility.
  5. Verify restored flow, document defects and plan repairs and repeat inspection.

Common causes: deposited grit and grease, roots, debris, illegal connections, pipe collapse, insufficient slope, settlement, corrosion and infiltration. Odour can arise from stagnant anaerobic sewage and hydrogen sulphide; investigate ventilation and underlying causes. Never assume smell or its absence proves a sewer atmosphere safe.
body.gu:
સામાન્ય procedure:

  1. Maps અને complaints તપાસી flow તથા અસરગ્રસ્ત reaches ઓળખો.
  2. Public protection, traffic control, equipment, isolation અથવા bypass અને notification નું આયોજન કરો.
  3. શક્ય હોય ત્યાં remotely inspect કરો; ઓછામાં ઓછી જોખમી mechanised cleaning method લો.
  4. એકત્ર material દૂર કરી authorised facility સુધી transport અને disposal કરો.
  5. Flow પુનઃસ્થાપિત થયો છે તે તપાસો, defects નોંધો અને repairs તથા repeat inspection આયોજન કરો.

સામાન્ય કારણો: જમા grit અને grease, roots, debris, illegal connections, pipe collapse, ઓછો slope, settlement, corrosion અને infiltration. Stagnant anaerobic sewage તથા hydrogen sulphide થી odour આવી શકે; ventilation અને મૂળ કારણો તપાસો. ગંધ આવે કે ન આવે તેના આધારે sewer atmosphere safe હોવાનું કદી ન માનો.

body.en:
Equipment and uses:

  • CCTV crawler or remote camera locates blockage, cracks, root intrusion and joint defects.
  • High-pressure jetting vehicle removes deposits when pipe condition permits; control pressure and prevent splashback.
  • Suction tanker removes loosened material and wastewater into a closed system for authorised disposal.
  • Mechanical rodding, cutters or remotely operated devices address specific obstructions using compatible pipe sizes and procedures.
  • Flow meters, locator equipment and barriers support diagnosis and site control.

Choose by obstruction, pipe diameter and strength, access, flow, downstream capacity and worker safety. Jetting can damage a weak pipe; do not apply a generic pressure setting without a risk assessment.
body.gu:
Equipment અને uses:

  • CCTV crawler અથવા remote camera blockage, cracks, root intrusion અને joint defects શોધે છે.
  • Pipe condition મંજૂરી આપે ત્યારે high-pressure jetting vehicle deposits દૂર કરે છે; pressure નિયંત્રિત કરી splashback અટકાવો.
  • Suction tanker છૂટેલું material અને wastewater closed system માં લઈ authorised disposal સુધી પહોંચાડે છે.
  • Mechanical rodding, cutters અથવા remotely operated devices, યોગ્ય pipe sizes અને procedures સાથે ચોક્કસ obstructions દૂર કરે છે.
  • Flow meters, locator equipment અને barriers diagnosis તથા site control માં મદદ કરે છે.

Obstruction, pipe diameter અને strength, access, flow, downstream capacity અને worker safety પ્રમાણે પસંદગી કરો. Jetting થી નબળી pipe ને નુકસાન થઈ શકે; risk assessment વગર સામાન્ય pressure setting ન વાપરો.

body.en:
Sewers may contain flammable methane or fuel vapours, toxic hydrogen sulphide and insufficient oxygen. Gas concentrations can change suddenly; hydrogen sulphide can disable the sense of smell. Flames, smoking, sparks and unapproved electrical equipment must be excluded.

Critical safety principles:

  • Do not enter to inspect, clean or rescue a collapsed person; call emergency services and use trained rescue arrangements.
  • Prefer mechanised non-entry methods. Hazardous manual sewer or septic-tank cleaning is prohibited under Indian law.
  • Any exceptional entry must comply with applicable law and formal confined-space permit, competent supervision, isolation, calibrated atmospheric monitoring, ventilation, protective equipment and a ready trained rescue team.
  • A mask alone does not supply oxygen or make a toxic atmosphere safe; an improvised rescue can cause multiple deaths.
body.gu:
Sewers માં flammable methane અથવા fuel vapours, ઝેરી hydrogen sulphide અને ઓછો oxygen હોઈ શકે. Gas concentrations અચાનક બદલાય છે; hydrogen sulphide ગંધ ઓળખવાની ક્ષમતા નિષ્ક્રિય કરી શકે છે. Flames, smoking, sparks અને unapproved electrical equipment દૂર રાખો.

મહત્વના safety principles:

  • Inspection, cleaning અથવા બેભાન વ્યક્તિના rescue માટે અંદર ન જાઓ; emergency services બોલાવી trained rescue arrangements વાપરો.
  • Mechanised non-entry methods ને પ્રાથમિકતા આપો. ભારતીય કાયદા હેઠળ hazardous manual sewer અથવા septic-tank cleaning પ્રતિબંધિત છે.
  • કોઈ exceptional entry લાગુ કાયદા અને formal confined-space permit, competent supervision, isolation, calibrated atmospheric monitoring, ventilation, protective equipment તથા તૈયાર trained rescue team મુજબ જ થાય.
  • માત્ર mask oxygen પૂરો પાડતો નથી કે toxic atmosphere safe બનાવતો નથી; અનિયોજિત rescue થી અનેક મૃત્યુ થઈ શકે.

body.en:
Given: A mechanised crew inspects 240 m of sewer in 3 hours. At the same average rate, estimate inspection time for 400 m, excluding setup and interruptions.

Step 1. Calculate inspection rate.

Rate = 240 / 3Rate = 80 m/h

Step 2. Calculate time for 400 m.

Time = 400 / 80

Final answer:

Estimated inspection time = 5 hours, excluding setup and interruptions.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Mechanised crew 3 hours માં 240 m sewer inspect કરે છે. સમાન average rate પર setup અને interruptions બાદ કરતાં 400 m માટે inspection time નો અંદાજ લો.

Step 1. Inspection rate ગણો.

Rate = 240 / 3Rate = 80 m/h

Step 2. 400 m માટે સમય ગણો.

Time = 400 / 80

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Setup અને interruptions સિવાય estimated inspection time = 5 hours.

title.en: Formulae, methods and key data — Unit 10
title.gu: Formulae, methods અને key data — યુનિટ 10

body.en:
Allow for setup, safety and site interruptions separately.

Average productivity = work completed / timeEstimated time = planned work / assumed productivity
body.gu:
Setup, safety અને site interruptions માટે અલગ allowance રાખો.

Average productivity = work completed / timeEstimated time = planned work / assumed productivity

q.en: Why maintain sewers?
q.gu: Sewers ની maintenance કેમ કરવી?

a.en: To prevent blockage, overflow and pollution.

q.en: What causes blockage?
q.gu: Blockage નું કારણ શું છે?

a.en: Grit, grease, roots, debris or structural failure.
a.gu: Grit, grease, roots, debris અથવા structural failure.

q.en: What causes sewer odour?
q.gu: Sewer odour નું કારણ શું છે?

a.en: Anaerobic conditions can release odorous gases.
a.gu: Anaerobic conditions માં odorous gases નીકળી શકે.

q.en: What is CCTV inspection?
q.gu: CCTV inspection શું છે?

a.en: Remote visual inspection using a sewer camera.
a.gu: Sewer camera વડે remote visual inspection.

q.en: What is jetting?
q.gu: Jetting શું છે?

q.en: What is a suction tanker?
q.gu: Suction tanker શું છે?

a.en: Equipment collecting wastewater and debris into a closed tank.
a.gu: Wastewater અને debris ને closed tank માં લેતું equipment.

q.en: What is hydrogen sulphide?
q.gu: Hydrogen sulphide શું છે?

a.en: A toxic gas that may occur in sewers.
a.gu: Sewers માં હોઈ શકે એવો toxic gas.

q.en: Is absence of smell proof of safety?
q.gu: ગંધ ન હોવી safety નો પુરાવો છે?

a.en: No; toxic gas can be present without a reliable warning smell.
a.gu: નહીં; વિશ્વસનીય warning smell વગર પણ toxic gas હોઈ શકે.

q.en: Why exclude flames?
q.gu: Flames કેમ દૂર રાખવી?

a.en: Flammable gas or vapour can ignite.
a.gu: Flammable gas અથવા vapour સળગી શકે.

q.en: What is a confined space?
q.gu: Confined space શું છે?

a.en: An enclosed space with restricted access and potential hazards.
a.gu: મર્યાદિત access અને સંભવિત hazards ધરાવતી બંધ જગ્યા.

q.en: Should an untrained person enter for rescue?
q.gu: Untrained વ્યક્તિએ rescue માટે પ્રવેશ કરવો જોઈએ?

q.en: Is a simple mask enough for oxygen deficiency?
q.gu: Oxygen deficiency માટે સામાન્ય mask પૂરતો છે?

a.en: No; it does not supply breathable air.
a.gu: નહીં; તે શ્વાસ માટે હવા પૂરી પાડતો નથી.

q.en: Describe the procedure for safe sewer maintenance.
q.gu: Safe sewer maintenance ની procedure વર્ણવો.

q.en: Explain causes of sewer troubles and odours.
q.gu: Sewer troubles અને odours ના કારણો સમજાવો.

q.en: Compare sewer cleaning equipment and its selection.
q.gu: Sewer cleaning equipment અને તેની પસંદગી સરખાવો.

q.en: Explain explosive-gas and confined-space safety measures.
q.gu: Explosive-gas અને confined-space safety measures સમજાવો.

q.en: State the use of CCTV inspection.
q.gu: CCTV inspection નો ઉપયોગ લખો.

q.en: State the function of a suction tanker.
q.gu: Suction tanker નું કાર્ય લખો.

q.en: Why are naked flames prohibited near sewers?
q.gu: Sewers પાસે naked flames કેમ પ્રતિબંધિત છે?

q.en: What should be done when a worker collapses in a sewer?
q.gu: Sewer માં worker બેભાન થાય તો શું કરવું?
